payload.title: the shared judge backend frames a purview act as a transcript
payload.body: At 11799c43 the purview guard hands its judge the rubric, the holder's contract and the act. But both judge seams it shares with the stance guards, stance-judge.sh on Claude Code and the in-process judge the omp bridge renders, wrap that payload as '=== BEGIN TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT (operator instruction + agent turn) ===' and close with 'Apply the rubric. Output ONLY the verdict block.' A purview payload holds no operator instruction and no agent turn, so the judge is told something false about what it reads. Under the shard, what a guard hands its judge is only what its one decision needs. This framing belongs to the shared backend, not to the purview worker, so it was not held against purview-guard-precise.
